opening.argument: The speaker promotes EasyBlock as a way to buy shares for $10, participate in StrongBlock-related nodes, and receive stated monthly returns of 30% in STRONG, with compounding presented as reaching 3,778% APY. The described structure pools investments to acquire a node, bridges its revenue, and distributes rewards to users, while the dashboard shows a share-purchase panel requiring approval. Viewers are also directed to claim rewards through a connected wallet. That combination of crypto participation, share purchases, node returns, and unusually high projected yield is a direct solicitation for investment. The disclaimer and fee explanation qualify the presentation but do not remove its high-return investment appeal.

citations.quote: You can buy shares at $10 each. And start earning 30% monthly returns in terms of STRONG by owning parts of STRONGblock nodes. By compounding your earnings, you can get up to 3,778% APY.
When people buy shares, the investments are accumulated.
